plan: Given my private value of $26, I should bid slightly below my value to maximize profit if I win. Since all bidders are rational, they will also bid close to their values. To avoid overbidding and risking a loss, I should bid slightly below $26, anticipating others may bid similarly. A bid of $25.9 could win if others bid lower or close to their values.

Since this is the only round, I will aim to win the auction while minimizing costs. My private value is $31. To benefit, I must bid below $31, ensuring the cost is less than my value. A bid slightly above half my value, say $16, could deter others from overbidding while keeping potential profit. Bidding exactly $31 risks no profit or loss if I win.

Given my value of $24, I aim to bid slightly above the expected average bid to maximize profit. Rational bidders will bid below their value to ensure profit if they win. Assuming values are uniformly distributed, the average value is $24.5. A bid around $20 should be competitive, allowing room for profit if I win, as the third-highest bid will likely be lower. This balances risk and potential gain, considering no prior history.
